title: An AI Tool That Predicts Breast Cancer Risk Is Now Available Nationwide
key_facts: Clairity Breast, an AI tool that predicts five-year breast cancer risk from a screening mammogram, is available nationwide through Everlywell's platform.
Women need a qualifying screening mammogram from the past 12 months; a licensed clinician in Everlywell's network orders and reviews the assessment.
It works only with Hologic mammograms and does not detect or diagnose cancer.
The assessment costs $249 out of pocket and is not covered by insurance.
A 'high-risk' result means a 3% or greater chance over five years, still low in absolute terms.
Outside expert Jean Bao of Stanford says the tool ignores family history and atypia and may cause anxiety or extra imaging.
Bao says FDA authorization shows the tool is safe, not that it improves outcomes.
quote_evidence: The software doesn't detect or diagnose cancer, and it doesn't provide care recommendations, says Lehman.
Omitting these clinical factors from a clinical risk tool is a real limitation.
why_it_matters_hint: A mammogram-based AI risk score is now sold directly to women for $249, with experts urging caution about its limits.
